ayahs.en: Recite in the name of your Lord who created
ayahs.e2: Read, ˹O Prophet,˺ in the Name of your Lord Who created—
ayahs.tr: Iqra bismi rab bikal lazee khalaq

ayahs.en: Created man from a clinging substance
ayahs.e2: created humans from a clinging clot

ayahs.en: Recite, and your Lord is the most Generous
ayahs.e2: Read! And your Lord is the Most Generous

ayahs.en: Taught man that which he knew not
ayahs.e2: taught humanity what they knew not
ayahs.tr: Al lamal insaana ma lam y'alam

ayahs.e2: Most certainly, one exceeds all bounds
once they think they are self-sufficient

ayahs.en: Indeed, to your Lord is the return
ayahs.e2: ˹But˺ surely to your Lord is the return ˹of all˺

ayahs.en: Have you seen the one who forbids
ayahs.e2: Have you seen the man who prevents

ayahs.en: Have you seen if he is upon guidance
Have you seen if he denies and turns away
ayahs.e2: What if that ˹man˺ persists in denial and turns away
ayahs.tr: Ara-aita in kaz zaba wa ta walla

ayahs.en: Does he not know that Allah sees
ayahs.e2: Does he not know that Allah sees ˹all˺
ayahs.tr: Alam y'alam bi-an nal lahaa yaraa

ayahs.ar: كَلَّا لَئِن لَّمۡ يَنتَهِ لَنَسۡفَعَۢا بِٱلنَّاصِيَةِ
ayahs.en: No! If he does not desist, We will surely drag him by the forelock
ayahs.e2: But no! If he does not desist, We will certainly drag him by the forelock—
ayahs.tr: Kalla la illam yantahi la nasfa'am bin nasiyah

ayahs.en: Then let him call his associates
ayahs.e2: So let him call his associates

ayahs.en: We will call the angels of Hell
ayahs.e2: We will call the wardens of Hell

ayahs.en: No! Do not obey him. But prostrate and draw near [to Allah]
ayahs.e2: Again, no! Never obey him ˹O Prophet˺! Rather, ˹continue to˺ prostrate and draw near ˹to Allah˺
